rows.text: • The Company updates its full year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to approximately $3.76, and reaffirms its previous full year adjusted EPS midpoint of approximately $4.70
In addition, the Company introduces estimated fourth quarter 2026 GAAP EPS from continuing operations guidance of approximately $1.07 and adjusted EPS of approximately $1.15.
• The Company updates its full year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to approximately $3.86 to $4.06, and reaffirms guidance provided on July 14 of EPS on an adjusted basis of approximately $4.60 to $4.80

In addition, the Company introduces estimated third quarter 2026 GAAP EPS from continuing operations guidance of approximately $0.97 to $1.00, down approximately 11 percent to 13 percent compared to the prior year period, and adjusted EPS of approximately $1.05 to $1.08, down approximately 13 percent to 15 percent compared to the prior year period.
